content.value: A 100 KVA transformer has 400 turns on the primary and 80 turns on the secondary. The primary and secondary resistances are 0.3 Ω and 0.01 Ω respectively and corresponding leakage reactances are 1.1Ω and 0.035 Ω respectively. The supply voltage is 2200 V. Calculate –
(i) equivalent impedance referred to primary (ii) the voltage regulation and the secondary terminal voltage for full load having a power factor of 0.8 leading.

_source_title: B. Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
